bio.text: Shontel Brown represents Ohio's 11th Congressional District in the U.S. House; she was first elected in 2021 and sworn in on November 4, 2021.
She entered public service in 2012 as a Warrensville Heights city council member and in 2014 was elected to the Cuyahoga County Council.
Before elected office she worked as a marketing professional and founded a technology-solutions small business; she lives in Warrensville Heights, Ohio.
